caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic plate shown from two perspectives: a top view and a side view. The plate is predominantly brown with darker and lighter brown tones that suggest shading and depth. In the top view, the central part of the plate features the inscription "1801" with decorative lines and patterns surrounding it, including a ring of text along the inner wall of the plate and wavy lines encircling the inner circle. The rim of the plate is slightly scalloped or uneven. The side view below the top view shows the shallow depth of the plate and repeats the wavy line pattern along the outer edge of the body. Both the top and side views are carefully rendered with attention to texture and color variation, resting on a plain off-white background. At the bottom right, there is a small signature reading "HUMAGALLI."
title: Pa. German Dish
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
